## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --locked`
- [ ] SDK or adapter tests, if relevant

- [ ] Docs updated, if public behavior changed
